patch_list: Back up memories

Adds Back up all memories to the patch settings. Saves every memory as separate back and front photos with the time, place and caption, plus the BTS video. The JSON sidecars hold location, friends' usernames and comments, and go to Downloa…
Change download location
Saves downloaded BeReals to Pictures/BeReal, DCIM/BeReal or a folder you pick. Requires Android 10 or newer.
Custom location
Sets the location shown on your BeReal to a place you choose on a map or by name.
Custom retake count
Asks before each BeReal how many retakes your friends see on it.
Disable data collection
Turns off ad tracking, Firebase crash reports and sessions, Amplitude and Datadog analytics, Adjust attribution and the Shake bug reporter.
Disable typing indicator
Stops showing friends that you're typing in a chat. You still see when they type.
Disable view receipts
Stops sending which BeReals you viewed and which chats you opened.
Post from gallery
Adds a gallery button to the camera for picking the back and front photo of your BeReal.
Remove ads
Removes ads and sponsored BeReals from both feeds and the full-screen ad at launch, and stops the ad networks from loading.
Remove contacts permission
Removes the contacts permission. BeReal can't ask for or read your phone's contacts.
Remove friend suggestions
Removes suggested friends, contacts on BeReal and popular accounts from Friends and the feed.
Remove Friends of Friends prompts
Removes the "Share with Friends of Friends" card and the end-of-feed messages.
Remove Friends of Friends tab
Removes the Friends of Friends tab from the home screen.
Remove late flag
Sends BeReals you take after the moment's window as on time. Friends don't see a late tag.
Remove late label
Removes the late label from friends' BeReals. Each one shows how long ago your friend posted it.
Remove promotions
Removes Recap cards, the "How's BeReal?" review prompt, the profile completion card, the notifications banner and the music tooltip.
Remove streak prompts
Removes the offers to recover your streak and the Save your streak sheet. Your streak count doesn't change.
Remove update prompts
Removes BeReal's required and suggested update popups and the Play Store update prompt.
Remove watermark
Saves downloaded BeReals at full size without the BeReal logo.
Save friends' BeReals
Adds Download to the 3-dot menu of friends' BeReals in the feed and on the RealMoji screen.
Show friends' posts before posting
Shows friends' BeReals in My Friends and Friends of Friends before you post your own.
